<thought>Using the high‑resolution ESI‑MS data, the most intense ion is at m/z 141.1154, which corresponds to the protonated molecular ion [M+H]⁺. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral exact mass of ≈140.1081 Da. The formula that matches this exact mass within sub‑ppm error and is consistent with the observed ~9 % M+1 isotopic intensity is C₈H₁₄NO (neutral mass 140.1075 Da). In the required format CxHyOzX, this is C8H14O1N.</thought>
<final_answer>C8H14O1N</final_answer>
